extracted.name: Somali Baasto
extracted.description: This is a Somali comfort dish I grew up eating and has now become one of my favorite meals that remind me of home
instruction_lines: Add olive oil to skillet on medium-high heat
Once hot, sauté onion and garlic for 2-3 minutes then add in ground beef
Once ground beef starts to brown, add in potatoes, green peppers, cilantro, coriander, paprika, cumin, and all purpose seasoning
Once ground beef is fully cooked, add in crushed tomatoes
Once sauce starts to bubble, cover and reduce heat to low and let sit for 15-20 minutes
While sauce is cooking, make spaghetti according to package instructions
Once sauce is cooked, add spaghetti to a dish and top with sauce and serve immediately
